_readme: Standing approval for the PR autopilot. Only Lisa changes this file. An agent must never edit it (any change to it is a Do-card item).
approval_wording: Lisa pre-approves: merge commit only, when every check is green, there is no conflict, no sensitive path is touched and the privacy guard passes. Also: update branches, retarget a child PR to main once its parent has merged, and delete the head branch after a merge. Never squash, never rebase, never delete an unmerged branch.
renewal: Holds until Lisa says stop. Renewal is raised only if an internal policy rule requires it (scope widened, new repo type, privacy rule change); then ONE bulk Do card, never one per PR. Handover and new sessions carry this clause.
